content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record states only that the Agency 'concluded that Complainant failed to prove' discrimination, with no evidence or reasoning linking the allegations to that conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"gap","note":"The only sourced fact is RMO awareness of race and color ('ROI at 101'); the allegations (e.g., the 'U.S. Marshals' threat, monitoring by Witness 1, the job-abandonment basis) are not tied to testimony, documents, or management responses."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Key dates are given (termination September 18, 2020; complaint October 9, 2020; FAD March 3, 2022), but items 1c and 1e are undated, and the September 18 termination conflicts with the September 19 policy accusation and stay-away email and the September 24 separation email citing no-shows since September 18."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who decided the FAD, what legal standard or burden-shifting framework was applied, or whether management's explanations and Complainant's rebuttal were weighed; it notes only that no hearing was requested."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Without documented evidence, analysis, a decision-maker, or a coherent termination chronology, an independent reviewer could not tell from this record whether the no-discrimination finding is supported."}}}
